summary.headline: SaVida Health secures $412K in annual savings across 5 spend categories; $358K already locked in
summary.narrative: Treya Partners’ six-month sourcing engagement with SaVida Health delivered measurable impact, finalizing a $358K annual reduction in EMR fees and surfacing an additional $54K of run-rate savings now moving through implementation across GPO, IT hardware and telecom. Leveraging contract renegotiation, a new Provista GPO agreement and carrier consolidation, the team optimized more than $2M in addressable spend. Remaining initiatives are signed or in late-stage negotiation and are expected to bring total verified savings to $412K once fully deployed.

impact.operational_improvements: Standardized national purchasing through Provista GPO, consolidated telecom circuits under a managed-services model, and introduced competitive bidding for IT hardware to streamline procurement and improve pricing transparency.
